zh.title: 移动端日期兼容性修复
zh.summary: 修复部分移动端浏览器因零点日期换算异常而无法打开插件的问题。

items.text: 修复部分 Android 浏览器将零点格式化为 24:00 时，插件打开后仅显示关闭按钮的问题，并修正同类的午夜日进度计算。

en.title: Mobile date compatibility fix
en.summary: Fixes plugin startup failures caused by midnight conversion on some mobile browsers.

items.text: Fixes the plugin showing only a close button on Android browsers that format midnight as 24:00, and corrects the related day-progress calculation around midnight.
